_note: Family trips (lib/trips; the database: *_family_trips.sql): at the check-in counter you add your partner(s) and children and pick what the trip is for. You pay for everyone (children at kidFare of the fare); each partner gets an invite to accept within inviteHours (declined or expired: their fare comes back to you), then flies in the seat beside yours. needs: who can pick it (married: with a partner you're married to; expecting: while you're expecting a baby). kidFare and inviteHours are mirrored by trip_rule() in SQL, checked by scripts/check-life-config.mjs.
